home.subtitle: IT Specialist & FileMaker / Web Developer
home.description: IT professional specialized in Claris FileMaker solutions and Full-Stack web application development, based in the Canary Islands.

about.description: As an IT specialist and Full-Stack developer, I design and implement complete web applications, integrating frontend and backend with a focus on performance, scalability, and quality.

details.macos: Administration and optimization of macOS development environments, including system configuration, security, automation, and advanced troubleshooting.
details.windows: Advanced management of Windows environments in corporate and technical contexts, focused on configuration, automation, and support for development teams.
details.linux: Administration of Linux systems in development and server environments, including service management, networking, and operational troubleshooting.
details.networking: Design, configuration, and troubleshooting of networks, with solid knowledge of connectivity, security, and issue diagnosis.
details.docker: Containerization of applications and development environments, ensuring portability, consistency, and deployment efficiency.
details.git: Version control management and team collaboration through structured workflows and development best practices.
details.cicd: Basic automation of integration and deployment processes to improve delivery speed and quality.
details.vercel: Deployment and management of frontend applications in production environments, ensuring performance and efficient configuration.
details.cloudplatforms: Use of cloud services for application deployment and support, focused on scalable and reliable environments.
details.automation: Automation of technical and operational tasks to optimize processes and improve development environment efficiency.
